hero.filename: Map of Indochina Burma Siam China Railway 1886 Weller.png
hero.caption: Title: 'Map of Indo-China showing proposed Burma Siam China Railway.' The black line is the proposed Siamese railway from Bangkok to Yunnan and the Gulf of Martaban. The red line is the proposed British railway in British Burma. A short dotted line is open for traffic between Pegu and Toungoo in British Burma. Lithograph made by the British engraver and cartographer Edward Weller (1819 – 1884).
